lines.en: label futabaspring2:
scene sky
A long time ago, I used to visit the library pretty frequently. And one of the key reasons for that was how Futaba was among the most...{i}accepting{/i} of my advances early on.
lines.zh: 很久以前，我常常去图书馆。其中一个关键原因是，Futaba 是最早对我的接近最{i}来者不拒{/i}的人之一。

lines.en: Of course, I would subsequently learn that a great deal of that was the result of her nearly-absent self-esteem. But it’s not like I knew that {i}immediately.{/i}
lines.zh: 当然，后来我才知道，那在很大程度上是她几乎不存在的自尊心造成的结果。但我并不是{i}一开始就{/i}明白这一点。

lines.en: It took a few visits first. And {i}in{/i} those first few visits, I learned that there is and {i}was{/i} far more to her than just the flaws she gets hung up on.
lines.zh: 那花了我几次拜访。而{i}在{/i}最初的几次拜访中，我了解到她的内涵远远不止那些让她纠结不已的缺点。

lines.en: There’s a girl in there who wants to succeed and wants to be recognized. But the one she wants to be recognized {i}by{/i} is herself rather than me.
lines.zh: 在她心里，有一个想要成功、想要被认可的女孩。可她最想{i}被{/i}认可的对象是她自己，而不是我。

lines.en: Well, she definitely wants to be recognized by {i}me{/i} too. But I have “recognized” her many times by now and she is still unhappy, so I imagine I’m in second place at best.
lines.zh: 嗯，她当然也想被{i}我{/i}认可。可我已经「认可」过她很多次了，她依然不快乐，所以我想我充其量只能排第二。

lines.en: Regardless, I think back on these days as I swallow my pride and return to the halls I used to wander on a daily basis.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，当我咽下自尊、回到那些我曾经每天游荡的走廊时，我还是会想起那些日子。

lines.en: scene futabatree1
And what I find is that same girl, enduring that same struggle she suffered so long ago in trying to put her feelings onto paper.
lines.zh: 而我所见到的，还是那个同样的女孩，还在承受着很久以前她试图把感情写进纸上时同样的挣扎。

lines.en: And I can’t help but wonder if she’s gotten better now that I have forced her into feeling everything one possibly {i}can{/i} before even finishing her first year of high school.
lines.zh: 而我不禁想知道，在我逼着她在高中第一年还没念完之前就尝遍了一个人{i}可能{/i}尝到的所有感受之后，她是不是变好了。

lines.en: Writing is hard, though. Describing how you feel is {i}hard.{/i} And there are only so many words you can do it {i}with,{/i} which makes it even harder.
lines.zh: 不过写作很难。描述自己的感受{i}很难{/i}。而你能{i}用来{/i}描述的词就那么多，这让事情更难了。

lines.en: : Mnh...
lines.zh: : Mnh...

lines.en: I guess there’s a good chance she’s just writing smut instead, though. Since that seems to be what she’s most interested in now that she has discovered the joys of elf sex.
lines.zh: 不过我想，也很有可能在写的其实是色情小说。毕竟自从她发现了精灵性爱的乐趣之后，那似乎成了她最感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: : This is...much harder than I thought it would be. Maybe I should try a different story instead?
lines.zh: : 这……比我想象的要难多了。也许我该换个故事试试？

lines.en: : Talent in the world of writing doesn’t come immediately, Futaba. It’s a skill that’s acquired as time goes on.
lines.zh: : 写作上的天赋不是立刻就有的，Futaba。那是随着时间推移才能习得的技能。

lines.en: : {size=-1}For example — Mark Twain didn’t write the Adventures of Huckleberry Finn until he was almost 50 years old. Which means he must have gotten good at writing sometime after that since that book sucked.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}比如说——马克·吐温快五十岁了才写出《哈克贝利·费恩历险记》。也就是说，他一定是在那之后才擅长写作的，因为那本书烂透了。{/size}

lines.en: : That doesn’t help me at all, Sensei. Not when the deadline for submissions is-
lines.zh: : 那对我一点帮助都没有，Sensei。尤其是在截稿日期就——

lines.en: scene futabatree2
: Wait, Sensei? When did {i}you{/i} get here? I didn’t even hear you walk in.
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei？{i}你{/i}什么时候来的？我都没听到你进来。

lines.en: : Probably because you’re so absorbed in whatever you’re working on. Which may or may not be smut.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你太专注于自己在写的东西了。那东西可能是色情小说，也可能不是。

lines.en: scene futabatree3
: It’s not {i}smut.{/i} I know better than to write things like that in school.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}色情小说{/i}。我还不至于傻到在学校里写那种东西。

lines.en: : Didn’t you give me a boob job in the nurse’s office once?
lines.zh: : 你不是曾经在保健室给我做过一次乳交吗？

lines.en: scene futabatree4
: She was off that day. Which means I did nothing wrong.
lines.zh: : 那天她不在。所以我没有做错任何事。

lines.en: : Is she off today too? Want to drop what you’re doing and go relive some happy memories?
lines.zh: : 她今天也不在吗？要不要放下手头的事，去重温一些美好的回忆？

lines.en: scene futabatree5

: As {i}nostalgic{/i} as it sounds to help get you off after you went through the trouble of coming all the way over here, I can’t right now. I have to finish this story by tonight or I miss my chance.
lines.zh: : 你大老远跑过来，帮你释放一下听起来是挺{i}怀旧{/i}的，但现在不行。我今晚必须把这个故事写完，否则就错过机会了。

lines.en: : Your chance to {i}what?{/i} Is Wakana holding another writing contest or something?
lines.zh: : 错过{i}什么{/i}机会？Wakana 又在办写作比赛之类的吗？

lines.en: : Miss Watabe isn’t, but there’s a contest I found online to put a creative spin on a children’s book. So I’ve been working on that all week.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师没有，但我在网上找到一个比赛，是要对一本童书做创意改编。所以我整周都在忙这个。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Can I see what you have done?
lines.zh: : 哦？能让我看看你写了什么吗？

lines.en: scene futabatree6
: It might not be as pleasurable as my first suggestion, but grading your unfinished writing is still {i}nostalgic{/i} in its own way, is it not?
lines.zh: : 也许没有我第一个提议那么让人愉悦，但批改你未完成的稿子，本身也算是一种{i}怀旧{/i}，不是吗？

lines.en: : It is...It’s just my first time trying to...parody something, so to speak. And I’m worried that what I {i}do{/i} have will look pretty terrible compared to the original story.
lines.zh: : 算是吧……只是这是我第一次试着……算是戏仿吧。而且我担心我{i}写出来的东西{/i}，和原作一比会显得相当糟糕。

lines.en: : What’s the original story? Which children’s book are you trying to put a spin on?
lines.zh: : 原作是什么？你想改编哪本童书？

lines.en: : The Giving Tree by Shel Silverstein.
lines.zh: : 谢尔·希尔弗斯坦的《爱心树》。

lines.en: scene futabatree7
: Well, on the bright side, it’ll be hard for you to write anything even remotely as depressing as {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，往好处想，你很难写出哪怕有{i}它{/i}一半压抑的东西。

lines.en: : You think The Giving Tree is depressing, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得《爱心树》很压抑吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : A tree spends its entire existence catering to an ungrateful boy who ultimately chops it down and turns it into a boat? It’d take a fool to think something like that is happy.
lines.zh: : 一棵树用尽一生去迁就一个忘恩负义的男孩，最后还被他砍倒、造成一条船？只有傻瓜才会觉得那是幸福的故事。

lines.en: scene futabatree8
: Well, I guess you can call me a fool then. Because {i}I{/i} don’t think it’s as sad as you’re making it sound.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那你大概可以叫{i}我{/i}傻瓜了。因为我不觉得它有你说的那么悲伤。

lines.en: : Of course you don’t. Because you’re in that bracket of people who don’t mind sacrificing themselves for others even when it means you’re going to wind up hurting.
lines.zh: : 你当然不觉得。因为你属于那一类人——哪怕最后会伤到自己，也不介意为别人牺牲自己。

lines.en: : And {i}you’re{/i} in that bracket of people who don’t mind chopping down a tree you’ve grown up with so long as it benefits you in some way.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}属于那一类人——只要对自己有好处，砍倒一棵陪自己长大的树也无所谓。

lines.en: : You’re right. You don’t need to worry about me turning you into a boat, though. We’d probably just both drown if I tried to do that.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。不过你不用担心我会把你造成一条船。要是真那么做，我们大概会一起淹死。

lines.en: scene futabatree9
: Well, what {i}would{/i} you try to do, Sensei? Because I think your outlook might be really helpful here since I’m trying to approach this story from the opposite angle.
lines.zh: : 那你{i}会{/i}怎么做，Sensei？因为我想从相反的角度来写这个故事，所以你的看法可能很有帮助。

lines.en: : You mean, like...a “Taking Tree” instead of a “Giving Tree?”
lines.zh: : 你是说，比如……「索取的树」而不是「爱心树」？

lines.en: : Exactly. And it’s from the perspective of the boy instead this time, who sees the tree more like a curse than something beneficial to him.
lines.zh: : 正是。而且这次是从男孩的视角出发，在他眼里，那棵树与其说是对他有益的东西，不如说更像一道诅咒。

lines.en: : I’ve obviously had to change a few things in order for it to make sense, but the format is the same. And I got Maya to help me draw some of the pictures to keep the kids entertained.
lines.zh: : 为了让它说得通，我显然改动了一些地方，不过格式是一样的。我还找了 Maya 帮忙画一些插图，好让孩子们看得开心。

lines.en: : Maya can draw? Since when?
lines.zh: : Maya 会画画？什么时候开始的？

lines.en: scene futabatree10
: Since always, I think. I’m surprised you didn’t know.
lines.zh: : 我想一直都会吧。我很惊讶你居然不知道。

lines.en: : She actually used to draw quite a bit for the manga club until Molly started making too many demands and Maya stopped just to spite her.
lines.zh: : 她以前其实为漫画社画了不少，直到 Molly 开始提太多要求，Maya 就故意停笔了，纯粹是为了气她。

lines.en: : Yeah, that tracks. Aren’t you worried a story like this might be too dark for kids, though? Like, what’s the takeaway supposed to be in a book about a cursed tree?
lines.zh: : 嗯，这很符合她。不过你不担心这种故事对孩子来说太黑暗了吗？比如，一本讲被诅咒的树的书，想传达什么？

lines.en: scene futabatree11
: {i}The takeaway is supposed to be that there are always going to be things out there that want to hurt you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}想传达的是，这世上永远都会有想要伤害你的东西存在。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And yeah, I guess that might be a little dark for a children’s book. But it’s an important theme to explore, I think. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，我想这对童书来说可能有点黑暗。但我觉得这是个值得探讨的重要主题。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And it might help some kids understand bullying a little better if they ever have to experience that. Which...they probably will. Most people do.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且如果有些孩子将来真的要经历霸凌，这也许能帮他们更好地理解它。而……他们很可能会。大多数人都会。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Were you ever bullied, Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你以前被霸凌过吗，Sensei？{/i}

lines.en: scene futabatree12
: Not really. But anyway, if that’s the angle you want to go with, I’m sure it’s doable. Especially with your outlook and...{i}experience{/i} in the subject matter.
lines.zh: : 算不上。不过话说回来，如果你想走这个角度，我相信是可行的。尤其是凭你的看法和……在这个题材上的{i}经验{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes, I’m a bit of an expert in the field of being bullied, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊，在被霸凌这个领域，我还算是个专家了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Just means you’re stronger now.
lines.zh: : 那只是说明你现在更坚强了。

lines.en: : It doesn’t really. That {i}is{/i} the approach I’m taking from a writer’s perspective, though — showing how years of the tree’s {i}curse{/i} sort of help the boy build up an immunity to it.
lines.zh: : 其实并不。不过这{i}正是{/i}我从写作者角度采取的处理方式——展现那棵树的{i}诅咒{/i}如何年复一年地，算是帮那个男孩建立起了对它的免疫力。

lines.en: : How exactly does a tree {i}take{/i} something, though?
lines.zh: : 可一棵树到底怎么{i}「索取」{/i}东西？

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like it’s {i}physically{/i} taking anything. But it looms over his house, and every time  he sees its shadow cross into his yard, something bad happens.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，它又不是真的拿走了什么{i}实体{/i}的东西。但它笼罩着他的房子，每当他看到它的影子投进自家院子，就会有坏事发生。

lines.en: : That’s not the {i}tree’s{/i} fault though, is it? It can’t control its own shadow.
lines.zh: : 可那不是{i}树{/i}的错，对吧？它又控制不了自己的影子。

lines.en: : No, but the boy is just a boy. So {i}he{/i} doesn’t know that. Which is why he gives the tree an evil voice whenever he visits it to ask it to leave him alone.
lines.zh: : 是，可那男孩只是个男孩。所以{i}他{/i}不知道这一点。所以他每次去找那棵树、求它放过自己的时候，都会给它配上一个邪恶的声音。

lines.en: : Then, by the time he’s old enough to understand how shadows work, he’s already associated the tree with horrible things happening. Hence the “curse.”
lines.zh: : 然后，等他长大到明白影子是怎么一回事的时候，他已经把那棵树和可怕的事情联系在一起了。于是就有了「诅咒」。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: scene futabatree13
: You hate it, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢，对吧？

lines.en: : No, I don’t {i}hate{/i} it. I haven’t even read it yet. It’s just...do you think something like this would have helped you when {i}you{/i} were little?
lines.zh: : 不，我不{i}讨厌{/i}。我都还没读过。只是……你觉得这种东西在{i}你{/i}小的时候会帮到你吗？

lines.en: : Because if it’s from the boy’s perspective and it’s all just cursing this tree that isn’t really {i}doing{/i} anything, it’s sort of just...the Giving Tree {i}again{/i} but with different, sadder narration.
lines.zh: : 因为如果它是从男孩的视角出发，通篇只是在诅咒一棵其实什么都没{i}做{/i}的树，那它就有点像……{i}另一本{/i}《爱心树》，只是换了一套更悲伤的旁白。

lines.en: scene futabatree14
: Yeah...that’s exactly my problem. No matter what I do, I can’t figure out how to actually make the tree {i}evil.{/i} And the boy keeps forgiving it in the end.
lines.zh: : 是啊……这正是我的问题。不管我怎么做，都想不出要怎么让那棵树真的变成{i}邪恶{/i}的。而那个男孩到最后总是会原谅它。

lines.en: : But that’s not what I want. I {i}want{/i} him to hate it. And I {i}want{/i} him to chop it down and...get revenge for all of the terrible things it did but...didn’t {i}really{/i} do...
lines.zh: : 可那不是我{i}想{/i}要的。我{i}想{/i}让他恨它。我想让他把它砍倒，然后……为它做过、但……其实{i}根本{/i}没做过的那些可怕的事复仇……

lines.en: : But you know that wouldn’t send the message you want to send...
lines.zh: : 可你也知道，那样传达不出你想传达的信息……

lines.en: scene futabatree15
: Right...Which is why I keep thinking it might be better to just try and use a different story instead. But I really like this one and...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 没错……所以我一直在想，也许换个故事会更好。可我真的很喜欢这个，而且……我不知道。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s just me not being as good of a writer as I {i}want{/i} to be yet? Like, if I can’t get the simplest idea across in the simplest {i}format,{/i} what does that say about my skill?
lines.zh: : 也许只是我还没能达到自己{i}想要的{/i}写作水平？比如说，如果我连最简单的想法都用最简单的{i}形式{/i}表达不出来，那说明我的水平有多差？

lines.en: : Have I learned nothing at all this whole time? How come {i}I{/i} still suck while people like Nodoka can just write whatever they want and make it sound good?
lines.zh: : 这段时间{i}我{/i}什么都没学到吗？为什么我还是这么烂，而像 Nodoka 那种人想写什么就写什么，还都能写得很好听？

lines.en: scene futabatree16
: Comparing yourself to gifted people like that will always be a recipe for disaster, Futaba...
lines.zh: : 拿自己和那种天才比，永远都是一场灾难，Futaba……

lines.en: : Nodoka’s a very special and very {i}rare{/i} type of person. But it’s important to remember that people like that struggle even {i}harder{/i} sometimes because they don’t have anyone to relate to.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 是非常特别、非常{i}罕见{/i}的那类人。但重要的是要记住，那样的人有时候挣扎得{i}更厉害{/i}，因为他们找不到能和自己共鸣的人。

lines.en: scene futabatree17
: You and I are lucky we understand one another. We’re lucky we can sit here and identify the cracks in your story when {i}Nodoka{/i} likely wouldn’t even recognize them as cracks at all.
lines.zh: : 你和我能互相理解，这很幸运。我们能坐在这儿指出你故事里的裂缝，而 {i}Nodoka{/i} 大概根本不会把它们当成裂缝——这很幸运。

lines.en: scene futabatree18
: That’s...fair.
lines.zh: : 这……有道理。

lines.en: : Do you and I really understand one another, though?
lines.zh: : 可你和我真的互相理解吗？

lines.en: : As much as we can, I think. With plenty of room for error, of course. I don’t know if it’s possible to ever really {i}fully{/i} understand someone.
lines.zh: : 我想，在能做到的范围内是理解的。当然，还留有很多出错的余地。我不知道人是不是真的有可能{i}完全{/i}理解另一个人。

lines.en: : I just know that if you’re trying to {i}force{/i} an idea across, it’s not going to work. It’ll come off as {i}preachy{/i}...or {i}inauthentic{/i}...or even worse — it could come off as Huckleberry Finn.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，如果你想{i}硬把{/i}一个想法塞给读者，那是行不通的。它会显得{i}说教{/i}……或者{i}不真诚{/i}……或者更糟——它可能会变得像《哈克贝利·费恩》一样。

lines.en: scene futabatree19
: Why am I just learning today that you have such great disdain for Huckleberry Finn?
lines.zh: : 为什么我今天才知道你这么鄙视《哈克贝利·费恩》？

lines.en: : Why am {i}I{/i} just learning today that you are trying to {i}write{/i} behind my back when I am supposed to be your writing coach? We had an agreement.
lines.zh: : 为什么{i}我{/i}今天才知道，我明明是你的写作指导，你却背着我偷偷{i}写{/i}东西？我们说好的。

lines.en: : Did we? Why am I learning right now that you actually care about my writing? I figured you gave up on that once we started having sex.
lines.zh: : 有吗？为什么我现在才知道你其实在乎我的写作？我以为我们一开始上床，你就放弃那件事了。

lines.en: : That came out meaner than I wanted it to. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 那话说得比我本意要刻薄。抱歉。

lines.en: scene futabatree20
: Don’t be. You’re clearly not the only one here struggling to get their feelings across. And I’m sure it hasn’t helped at all that I just walked away from school entirely.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。显然这里不是只有你一个人在费力表达自己。而我干脆彻底离开了学校，肯定也没起到任何帮助。

lines.en: : I don’t actually blame you for writing “behind my back.” I was just being a facetious douche again.
lines.zh: : 我其实并没有怪你「背着我」写东西。我只是又在装腔作势地当混蛋而已。

lines.en: scene futabatree21
: Wait, are you okay? Because I suddenly feel {i}really{/i} bad about saying what I said if that’s your response to it.
lines.zh: : 等等，你还好吗？如果你的反应是这样，我突然为自己说的那些话感到{i}很{/i}过意不去。

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} okay? Because if you’ve spent the last week wanting to murder a fictional tree for revenge, I can’t imagine you’re the same Futaba I’ve been jerking off to this whole time.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}还好吗？因为如果你这一整周都想着为了复仇去杀掉一棵虚构的树，我很难想象你还是我这段时间一直对着打飞机的那个 Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabatree22
: That came out lewder than I wanted it to. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 那话说得比我本意要下流。抱歉。

lines.en: : Don’t be. I was masturbating to you before we ever even talked.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。在我们说上话之前，我就已经在对着你自慰了。

lines.en: : That makes me feel a lot better. Thank you, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 这让我好受多了。谢谢你，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabatree23
: What are we going to do about your story, though? It needs to be done by tonight, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那你的故事怎么办？今晚就得写完，不是吗？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} don’t need to do anything, Sensei. I’ll probably just go with my gut and finish “The Giving Tree Pt. II” and hope no one else submitted anything for the contest.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}什么都不用做，Sensei。我大概就凭直觉把《爱心树 2》写完，然后祈祷没有别人投稿参赛。

lines.en: : But maybe soon, I can try writing something...original again. And you can read that and tell me more about how inadequate it is or...what I need to {i}change.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过也许很快，我就能再试着写点……原创的东西。然后你可以读一读，再告诉我它有多不到位，或者……我需要{i}改{/i}什么。

lines.en: scene futabatree24
: Futaba, you’re a teenager. You don’t need to be {i}perfect.{/i} It would be weird if everything you wrote {i}was{/i} adequate. Having to change things is completely normal. For professionals too.
lines.zh: : Futaba，你是个十几岁的孩子。你不需要{i}完美{/i}。如果你写的每样东西都{i}够好{/i}，那才奇怪。需要改东西是完全正常的。职业作家也一样。

lines.en: : I know...I know. I just...kind of {i}need{/i} to win this. And that pressure isn’t...meshing well with everything else that’s been going on in my head lately.
lines.zh: : 我知道……我知道。我只是……有点{i}需要{/i}赢下这个。而这份压力和我最近脑子里发生的其他事情……不太合拍。

lines.en: : Why do you...{i}need{/i} to win a children’s book writing contest exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么……{i}需要{/i}赢下一个童书写作比赛？

lines.en: : Futaba-
lines.zh: : Futaba——

lines.en: : I need the money.
lines.zh: : 我需要钱。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m trying to go to America.
lines.zh: : 我想去美国。

lines.en: scene futabatree25
: You really {i}still{/i} haven’t heard anything from your parents? It’s been, like...over a year, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}还{/i}没收到你爸妈的任何消息？都已经……一年多了吧？

lines.en: : That’s why I want to go find them. It’s, like...{i}super{/i} weird. And unnerving. They’ve always trusted me to be independent, but they’ve never just...{i}left me alone{/i} for this long before.
lines.zh: : 那就是我想去找他们的原因。这真的……{i}超级{/i}诡异。而且让人不安。他们一直都很信任我的独立能力，可他们从来没这样……{i}把我扔下{/i}这么久。

lines.en: : But...money won’t be enough to get you to there. You know that, right? There’s still the matter of the barrier and-
lines.zh: : 可是……光有钱也不够让你到那儿。你知道的，对吧？还有那道屏障的问题，而且——

lines.en: : I just have to figure out how to get through it. {i}You{/i} did once, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我只要想出穿过它的办法就行了。{i}你{/i}曾经穿过去过，不是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t...really know. I just remember following Nodoka and...that’s pretty much it.
lines.zh: : 我……其实不太清楚。我只记得跟着 Nodoka 走，然后……差不多就这样。

lines.en: : Still, there has to be a way...there {i}has{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 可总该有办法的……{i}一定{/i}有的。

lines.en: : Don’t you think people are too...accepting of this? Being stuck here? Just...living our lives, completely unsure of when and {i}if{/i} we’ll ever be allowed to leave again?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得人们对这件事太……逆来顺受了吗？被困在这里？就这么……过日子，完全不知道我们什么时候、到底还{i}能不能{/i}离开？

lines.en: scene futabatree26
: Don’t you want to know what’s out there, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你不想知道外面有什么吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : What we’re missing?...
lines.zh: : 我们在错过什么？……

lines.en: : I...{i}do.{/i} But there are things about this world that don’t exactly make sense. So I’m hesitant to-
lines.zh: : 我……{i}想{/i}。可这个世界有些地方说不通。所以我有点犹豫——

lines.en: : Don’t you want to know what’s out there, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你不想知道外面有什么吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : What we’re missing?...
lines.zh: : 我们在错过什么？……

lines.en: scene futabatree27
: {i}Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How am I supposed to respond to that when you’ll just ignore anything I have to say?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你根本不会听我说什么，你让我怎么回应？……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What? Why would I-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？我为什么会——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t think it’s safe out there, Futaba. I think you should stay here. With me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得外面不安全，Futaba。我觉得你该留在这儿。和我在一起。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sensei...But my parents-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei……可是我爸妈——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What if you can’t find them?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}万一你找不到他们呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What if something happened?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}万一他们出事了呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then what, Futaba?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那又怎样，Futaba？……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then I find out what it was...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我就去弄清楚到底发生了什么……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t just keep waiting around, though...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我不能就这么一直等下去……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ve already tried that...and it’s driving me insane.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我已经试过了……而那快把我逼疯了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t take it anymore, Sensei...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我再也受不了了，Sensei……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I need something...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我需要点什么……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anything...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么都好……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I’m not going to find any of that in this town.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而在这座城市里，我一样都找不到。{/i}
